Energy security is national security—and it’s the foundation for lowering prices, increasing growth, and developing new technologies.

One of the most significant national security challenges of our time is the race for AI. If we want to outpace China, we need policy that ensures American innovation is fueled at home.

AI requires vast computing power, which means it requires abundant, reliable, and affordable energy. North Dakota should lead these efforts. We have more gas in the Bakken than we can use. Let’s turn it into electricity, power AI computing at sites near the gas source, and make more room in our pipelines for additional gas production. This will grow our production, solve our gas challenge, create a new industry, and help America lead in AI.

AI is the future, but it doesn’t run on wishful thinking—it runs on American energy. @POTUS gets it!
